column1: # Follow-up pre-registration — Block A, long-turn arm. Written BEFORE the first
# run of this arm, after the main Block A pass completed 30/30.
# NOT an amendment to experiment-manifest-orchestrate.tsv, which is complete and
# closed at 30 rows. This is a SEPARATE arm with its own results file, because
# it changes a factor: AGENTTEST_TURN_TIMEOUT is 1800 (P20's harness default)
# instead of the 900 the main pass used.
# WHY. Five of the main pass's 30 cells recorded `harness-void` with
# `turnDidNotEnd`, at 901s, 901s, 901s, 950s and 1738s elapsed — clustered
# exactly on the 900s per-turn timeout the campaign itself imposed. That bound
# was a guard-rail choice (so the harness's clean shutdown fires before the
# driver's kill), not part of P20's configuration. So the main pass's 23/25 is
# conditional on "turns that finish inside 900s", and the excluded five are the
# slow tail rather than a random sample — which biases that rate upward by an
# unknown amount.
# WHAT THIS DECIDES. Re-running exactly those five seeds at 1800s separates two
# possibilities that the main pass cannot:
#   - they grade  -> the voids were an artifact of my bound, and the honest
#                    pooled rate uses these outcomes at n=30
#   - they void again -> "the orchestrator sometimes does not end a turn at all"
#                    is a real property of the loop, worth its own cycle
#   [corrected 2026-08-29: the original text said "a P27 cycle"; no P27
#    exists in the roadmap. Prose only — no decision rule is affected.]
# Either answer is useful; leaving five cells silent is not.
# These five seeds were NOT graded by the main pass, so nothing is being
# re-run over or overwritten: the main results file still holds their void rows
# as the diagnostic record, and this arm records its own outcomes separately.
# Runner: TURN_TIMEOUT=1800 RUN_CAP=7200 \
#   CAMPAIGN_MANIFEST=<this> \
#   CAMPAIGN_RESULTS=docs/superpowers/research/experiment-results-orchestrate-turn1800.tsv \
#   python3 Tools/run-orchestrate-campaign.py
